summary: Dirt verge backing onto bush reserve, homes only across the road.
reasons: Homes 24 m+ away, across the road
Van and cars parked on this verge

best_section.where: Taringa Parade west side, bush verge about 25 m past the first bend north

drivers.seclusion: Eucalypt reserve directly behind the verge; the nearest homes are 24-28 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Pale dirt verge about as wide as the lane runs beside the kerb, with room to pull fully off; vehicles stand on it in Esri.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential road with light through traffic.
drivers.convention: Esri shows a boxy white van and a car parked on the bush verge near 185 m, and cars at the start.

flags: Low-lying: not an issue, elevation 64-67 m
Homes 18-22 m across the road further along at 129-201 m
sun_shade: Reserve trees shade the verge from the west in the afternoon; open to morning sun.
